# Nymrel Trust Scorecard

> A local-first browser diagnostic for versioned synthetic fixtures and bounded evidence supplied by the user.

## Application
- Diagnostic: https://score.nymrel.com/
- Source: https://github.com/nymrel/nymrel-trust-scorecard
- Nymrel: https://nymrel.com/

## Boundaries
- The application does not fetch the labeled website.
- A domain alone receives no score.
- Synthetic examples use reserved .example domains.
- Results do not certify readiness, compliance, live behavior, discoverability, ranking, or revenue.
- Manual evidence is evaluated locally in the browser.
